policy.objective: Operational campaign-readiness triage, not mathematical difficulty scoring or probability-of-solution estimation.
policy.first_reconnaissance_rule: Select only problems with a protected statement and a concrete bounded entry point visible from the protected formalization: finite/computational foothold, explicit split directions, recorded partial-result gap, or a finite-to-infinite bridge.
policy.prize_rule: Prize metadata is retained as prominence metadata only; it does not determine priority.
policy.status_hold_rule: Rows with informal status open but a reported formal Lean solution remain held until status and solution evidence are reconciled.
policy.source_debt_rule: Registry-reported formalizations outside the protected FC snapshot require protected refresh before campaign design; rows without a reported formalization require statement capture.
policy.solve_authority: MATH-PROGRAMME must separately select a problem and approve a concrete campaign package before MATHSOLVE execution.

claim_boundary: This triage ranks operational readiness and source state only. It does not prove that a problem is open, estimate mathematical difficulty or probability of solution, authorize Solve work, certify a theorem, or claim novelty or priority.
